agent_report.summary:
Reviewed PR #24 (Issue #23, unfinished-work carry-forward) against its acceptance criteria — all 13 covered by new Playwright tests, CI green, screenshots visually consistent, Codex had no findings. Branch was behind main, so I updated it, waited for CI, and squash-merged; Issue #23 closed and its `in-progress` label removed. Pages deployment for main succeeded and the site returns 200.

With that merged, every product mechanism in GOAL.md exists, but the pt-BR interface requirement (added to GOAL.md after Issue #23 was written) is unmet across the whole app: `lang="en"`, all strings English, and every `toLocaleDateString` call passing `undefined` so dates follow the visitor's browser. Created Issue #25 (`ready`) to translate the entire interface in one PR, with decisions pre-made (no i18n layer, hard-coded `'pt-BR'` locale, stored data untouched, native date/time widgets left alone), a fixed glossary, a flagged trap (pt-BR `weekday: 'narrow'` gives three ambiguous letter pairs in the week strip), and a guard test asserting no English whole-words survive in `body.innerText`.

Work in flight is now at the limit of 1, so nothing else was labelled; Issue #22 (Commitments 360px add-button defect) stays parked. Not DONE — pt-BR is a Definition-of-Done item and is currently unbuilt.
